title: TypeScript
description: Gates for a TypeScript or JavaScript repo. Each tool comes from the repo's node_modules, so its version is the one the lockfile pins.

gates.description: Lints the changed files with ESLint, warnings included: a warning nobody is sent back for is never fixed.

Type-checks the project with tsc, since a change in one file can break the types of another. Incremental: tsc keeps what it learnt under node_modules/.cache and re-checks only what the changed files reach.
Checks that Prettier leaves the changed files as they are.
Runs only the Vitest tests that import a changed file, directly or not.

Runs only the node:test tests that import a changed file, directly or not, for a repo that tests with Node itself. Node has no related mode: the helper follows the imports. It finds the tests by Node's own naming; --tests <regex> narrows it.
Fails on the copy-pasted blocks the turn added, never on the ones already there. An agent that misses an existing helper writes a second one, and the two drift apart.
Fails on the unused files, exports and dependencies the turn added, never on the ones already there, so it works on a repo that already has some.

Fails on the rule suppressions the turn added, never on the ones already there: eslint-disable, @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, @ts-nocheck, prettier-ignore, biome-ignore. The cheapest green is to silence the rule, and this is the gate that refuses it.
